rachel: Heads-up - after the variant swap some tenants see a sharp negative 'cache savings' on their cost card. Is this an attribution bug or intended?
ben: Attribution. Credits are keyed by SKU fingerprint; when we create a new SKU the ledger treats it as a new entity so previous prefetch credits don't show up under the new variant.
anita: UX options: (1) show a small "transfer" badge on the tenant card and keep numbers unchanged; (2) draw a rollforward arrow between rows; (3) synthesize a single rolled value. PM wants clarity + minimal surprise.
ben: Backend plan: emit a compact transfer event at rollout time with fields emitted into the econ stream: rollout_id, from_sku, to_sku, token_amount, timestamp. Econ export should tag transfer rows as `transfer=true` and `billable=false` so billing doesn't double-charge. We'll also precompute a daily lookup map keyed by rollout_id to avoid heavy joins.
rachel: For console: default to hiding transfer rows in the summary, but surface an affordance "Transfers (1)" that expands to show details and a small timeline. Add a tooltip: "Credits moved due to variant rollout."
anita: Also add a toggle on the cost card: "Show transfers" (off by default), and a short help link "why did my savings change?" that opens the timeline modal.
ben: API sketch: GET /internal/econ/stream?start=<ts>&end=<ts>&include_transfers=true. Transfer rows are emitted as lightweight rows alongside cost rows.
rachel: Alerting: create an econ-alert that fires if tenant net savings delta < -12% within 2h of a rollout and no transfer event exists; route to #econ-ops.
infra-bot: infra-bot: transfer-event schema PR opened in #pull-requests (link) 6 CI passing.
ben: Action items: @ben emit transfer events + daily map; @anita mock UI expand/collapse + toggle + tooltip; @rachel add alert rule + docs. I'll open backend PR today, estimate 1.5d.
rachel: Thanks all, will follow up with mock and docs link.
